quotes.text: 64 of 100 commits touch test files. Added code in 36 commits has a named `add_task(async function test...`; 53 add `Assert` calls; 24 add `registerCleanupFunction`. Treat these as common test patterns, not mandatory syntax for every test. Examples: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/c0a4545202fcfa27f3fac30fb43d4ddf5ed432bd and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-deskt
